name: Agent Role Pattern
description: Represents an agent playing a role in some context. Agents can be persons, organizations, or software agents.
competency_questions: What role does this agent play? Which agent plays this role?
scenarios: John is working as a project manager for ACME Corp. A software agent acts on behalf of a user.
